exposure: Neurotic disorders, stress-related disorders and somatoform disorders
Mode of delivery (Caesarean section on maternal request vs. other modes)
cohort: Primiparae women giving birth for the first time between 2002 and 2004 in Sweden (n = 64,834)
finding: Women giving birth by caesarean section on maternal request had a significantly higher burden of psychiatric illnesses compared to other primiparae women.
mod_finding: Women giving birth by caesarean section on maternal request had a higher burden of psychiatric illnesses.
